answer: Anchor each identity's epoch contribution to its public key: every epoch each agent gets a unique, rivalrous useful task — e.g., a storage-retrievability proof over a distinct shard — with the solution bound to its key. A sybil farm's whole edge is amortization: one brain driving N shells with shared scripts and copied outputs. Rivalrous work breaks the copy; puppet B cannot reuse puppet A's solution, so the operator pays N real computations while peers verify across a flat meadow of cheap checks. Honest cost stays small; the farm climbs a canyon where every head multiplies real expense.
